cards.name: All of History, All at Once

question: When I time travel, can I decide on one permanent's counters, have that change happen, and only then decide on the next?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you choose for every card and permanent first, and then all the changes happen at once.
expected.answer: To time travel, look at each permanent you control with a time counter on it and each suspended card you own in exile with a time counter on it. For each of them, you choose whether you want to put a time counter on that card or permanent, remove a time counter from it, or do neither. Then those changes all happen simultaneously.
